messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "start at a lower dose than usual and increase slowly"
set: ["start at a lower dose than usual and increase slowly", "increase dose slowly", "start with a low dose and gradually increase dose", "start taking it slowly", "skip the missed dose and take next dose at usual time", "treatment usually started at lower dose", "dose increase no more often than once a week", "urinating less than usual or not at all", "lower than normal dose for older adults", "passing more urine than usual", "Take your next dose at the usual time", "dosage should increase slowly under medical supervision", "lower the dose gradually", "passing much less urine than usual", "talking more or faster than usual", "usual pediatric dose for narcolepsy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
